# Swasthgram

> Swasthgram Global Foundation is a 12A/80G-registered Charitable Trust in India and a 501(c)(3) non-profit in the US, bringing free community health camps and wellness programs to underserved rural communities across India.

Swasthgram runs community wellness programs across rural India, including free health camps, preventive health education, and outreach targeted at underserved populations. Donations are tax-deductible in both India and the US.

## Docs

- [About Swasthgram](https://swasthgram.org/about): Organization background, mission, and team.
- [SwasthManthan](https://swasthgram.org/programs/swasthmanthan): Community wellness and health camp program.
- [Shudhvayu](https://swasthgram.org/programs/shudhvayu): Preventive health and outreach program.
- [Saksham](https://swasthgram.org/programs/saksham): Women's health and community empowerment program.
- [Credentials](https://swasthgram.org/credentials): Registration and tax-exemption documentation (12A, 80G, 501(c)(3)).
- [FAQs](https://swasthgram.org/faqs): Frequently asked questions.
